papers.title: Scalable Gaussian Processes for Supervised Hashing
papers.abstract: We propose a flexible procedure for large-scale image search by hash functions with kernels. Our method treats binary codes and pairwise semantic similarity as latent and observed variables, respectively, in a probabilistic model based on Gaussian processes for binary classification. We present an efficient inference algorithm with the sparse pseudo-input Gaussian process (SPGP) model and parallelization. Experiments on three large-scale image dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed hashing method, Gaussian Process Hashing (GPH), for short binary codes and the datasets without predefined classes in comparison to the state-of-the-art supervised hashing methods.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关于图像哈希搜索，与有限元代理模型或生物力学无关，无转移可能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, expensive simulation sampling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implant design, nor does it involve any structural or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用高斯过程提升大规模图像哈希检索的准确性。
summary_zh.method: 将二元码与成对语义相似度作为隐变量和观测变量，构建高斯过程二分类概率模型并采用SPGP进行推理。
summary_zh.result: 在三个大型图像数据集上，所提方法在短码和无预设类别场景下优于现有监督哈希方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在大型图像数据集上进行检索性能对比实验。

summary_en.motivation: To improve large-scale image retrieval accuracy using supervised hashing with Gaussian processes.
summary_en.method: A probabilistic model treats binary codes and pairwise semantic similarity as latent and observed variables, respectively, with Gaussian process binary classification and sparse pseudo-input GP (SPGP) for efficient inference.
summary_en.result: The proposed Gaussian Process Hashing (GPH) outperforms state-of-the-art supervised hashing on three large-scale image datasets, especially for short codes and datasets without predefined classes.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on three large-scale image datasets (e.g., CIFAR, NUS-WIDE) with retrieval metrics such as mean average precision.

papers.title: CMA-ES for Hyperparameter Optimization of Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Hyperparameters of deep neural networks are often optimized by grid search, random search or Bayesian optimization. As an alternative, we propose to use the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES), which is known for its state-of-the-art performance in derivative-free optimization. CMA-ES has some useful invariance properties and is friendly to parallel evaluations of solutions. We provide a toy example comparing CMA-ES and state-of-the-art Bayesian optimization algorithms for tuning the hyperparameters of a convolutional neural network for the MNIST dataset on 30 GPUs in parallel.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关于深度神经网络的超参数优化，与用户研究方向的代理建模或无约束优化问题无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve any FEA, surrogate modeling for physical simulations, constraints handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses solely on hyperparameter tuning for neural networks.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出CMA-ES用于深度神经网络超参数优化以替代网格搜索等方法
summary_zh.method: 使用CMA-ES进行并行超参数优化，并与贝叶斯优化对比
summary_zh.result: CMA-ES在MNIST数据集上的卷积神经网络调参中表现出竞争力
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过一个MNIST示例进行对比

summary_en.motivation: To propose CMA-ES as an alternative to grid search, random search, and Bayesian optimization for hyperparameter optimization of deep neural networks.
summary_en.method: Apply the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) to tune hyperparameters of a convolutional neural network on MNIST with parallel evaluation.
summary_en.result: CMA-ES achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art Bayesian optimization algorithms.
summary_en.validation: A toy example comparing CMA-ES and Bayesian optimization on a single dataset.

papers.title: Investigation of accuracy and dimensional limits of part produced in aluminum alloy by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Center for Space Human Robotics, Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia, Corso Trento, 21, 10129, Turin, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Flaviana Calignano
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Center for Space Human Robotics, Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia, Corso Trento, 21, 10129, Turin, Italy

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝合金的选择性激光熔化工艺精度，未涉及生物医用材料、多孔结构或应力屏蔽。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on manufacturing accuracy of aluminum alloy parts, with no mention of porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究铝合金SLM零件的精度和尺寸限制。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验测量不同尺寸零件的几何精度。
summary_zh.result: 确定了工艺参数对精度的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量与设计值比较。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the accuracy and dimensional limits of parts produced by selective laser melting in aluminum alloy.
summary_en.method: Experimental measurements of geometric accuracy on parts of various sizes were performed.
summary_en.result: Process parameters were found to influence the dimensional accuracy of the parts.
summary_en.validation: Validation was done by comparing measured dimensions to design values.
